dimensions.assessment: Affects public high school students turning of voting age, public high schools nationwide, state election officials, and the Department of Education.
dimensions.evidence: all public high schools (as defined in section 8101 of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act (20 U.S.C. 7801)) in the State

dimensions.assessment: Imposes mandatory annual voter registration duties on public high schools and creates new administrative processes for student voter sign-ups.
dimensions.evidence: A voter registration agency that is a public high school shall, at least once during each academic year, conduct a voter registration drive

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes such sums as may be necessary for fiscal year 2026 and subsequent years for the Secretary of Education to reimburse schools.
dimensions.evidence: There are authorized to be appropriated for payments under this subsection such sums as may be necessary for fiscal year 2026 and each succeeding fiscal year.

dimensions.assessment: Amends the National Voter Registration Act of 1993 to add public high schools as voter registration agencies and creates a new federal grant reimbursement program.
dimensions.evidence: amend the National Voter Registration Act of 1993 to require States to designate public high schools as voter registration agencies

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory change requiring ongoing annual voter registration drives in high schools nationwide.
dimensions.evidence: for fiscal year 2026 and each succeeding fiscal year

missing_information: Exact annual cost of reimbursing all public high schools for registration drives.
Specific number of public high schools and students that will participate.
importance_detail.rationale: Requires all public high schools to be designated as voter registration agencies, conduct annual voter registration drives, and establishes a federal reimbursement grant program.
